observed_failure: Supabase migration-history parity recovery was classified as requiring a Netlify production marker because GitHub control-plane files participated in runtime lane classification and the terminalizer treated every non-governance change as Netlify-hosted runtime.
root_cause: Production verification authority was not routed by deployment/runtime owner. Repository parity recovery, Supabase runtime, and Netlify runtime shared one terminal path.
prevention: .github/** is governance-only for runtime lane classification.
Supabase migration-history recovery is explicitly bounded and terminalized as runtime-not-applicable only when its non-governance scope is limited to canonical parity-recovery surfaces.
Non-Netlify runtime without a dedicated production readback fails closed with UNWIRED_NON_NETLIFY_RUNTIME_READBACK.
Terminal evidence records readback_mode and cannot claim deployment readback when it was not performed.
